builds.name: Robot Educator driving base

wheel_diameter_mm.note: Pybricks' official-model program; the 56 x 28 tyre (41897) on rim 56908, 56 mm by LDraw, rolls a little under its outer diameter.

axle_track_mm.note: Pybricks taken: it is the maintained official-model program; 114 is the older example's value. Neither says how it was measured; calibrate.

builds.name: TRACK3R

instructions.reason: LEGO's 31313 building instructions are in the EV3 home app, not at a stable URL found here.

builds.frame: the LDraw frame of Philo's sub-model '31313 - track3r.ldr' (LDU, -Y up): forward is +X (the way the IR sensor looks), right is -Z, the tracks' centrelines are at Z = -80 ± 220

wheel_diameter_mm.note: Over the rubber track (53992) on the 30.4 mm rims (56145) the model uses. A track slips; calibrate.

axle_track_mm.note: Rims at Z = -300 and Z = 140 LDU (440 LDU): track centreline to centreline. A tracked base turns with slip, so the calibrated value comes out larger.

footprint_mm.unit: mm (length along X, width along Z, height)
footprint_mm.note: Bounding box of every triangle in the sub-model, read by tools/extract-ldraw.ts (ldraw-models.json).

A.note: Read from the model's cable routing: each cable sub-model's two plugs sit at a brick socket and a device socket (ldraw-models.json#track3r).

placements.note: Brick rotated so its motor-port end (+Z of the brick) points forward (+X); screen up. The model fits the rechargeable battery (95646c01) although the 31313 set ships the brick with the AA cover (95646).
Output axis along Z; drives the rear rim at X = -160.
Front right, idler; 96 mm ahead of the driven rim.
